sources.title: H1 2026 issuer financial update
sources.supports: group revenue of €42.787bn, up from €40.634bn, including €656m adverse currency effect. FY2025 revenue was about €82.9bn and EBIT €6.1bn. The group’s AI trend report documents use

sources.title: Annual report / financial results
sources.supports: latest financial anchor used in packet

financial_anchor.caveat: FY2025 EBIT governs the pre-tax operating screen; direct report access was not reproduced in the independent audit.

ai_claim.claim: DHL Group describes scoped AI/digital mechanisms in route, load and network-capacity optimization, predictive maintenance and parcel/facility automation.
ai_claim.stage: E1; E2 only where management explicitly reports production use
ai_claim.scope: cost per delivered unit at fixed on-time/damage service, empty miles, stop density, asset utilization and retained margin
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled quality-adjusted company result tied to retained incremental cash was found.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: UPS and digital freight brokers and carrier-neutral optimization software can replicate tools or force gains through to customers.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Competitive capability does not by itself prove equal outcomes.

rights_limit: Shippers own commercial shipment information; DHL processes it for carriage and service. Cross-customer learning and retention depend on contracts and privacy rules.
materiality_summary: Five percent of the completed-year governing metric is €305m; public evidence does not establish an AI-attributed amount.

arithmetic.inputs: FY2025 EBIT €6.1bn; 5%; illustrative eligible operating-cost pool €10bn, efficiency 5%, realization 60%, retention 40%, recurring cost €100m
arithmetic.result: Illustrative €20m is below the €305m annual pre-tax operating hurdle; shipper savings are excluded.

g2_provisional: Open: E1/E2 evidence supports measurement, but E3 quality-adjusted causality and E4 cash retention are not established.
unresolved_questions: What share of eligible workload is in production?
What controlled quality-adjusted KPI result exists?
What do contracts permit for pooled learning and how much benefit is retained after recurring cost?
